items.new_text: Given a release is cut in a project that uses per-run event files, when event files are already merged and older than two weeks, then they are folded into the archive in a commit of their own before the release commit and no event is lost.
Given a release folds old event files, when other work is already staged or a run is still in flight, then the staged work stays out of the fold commit and the run's event files are left alone.
Given the fold at release meets a conflict, a missing base, a file it cannot delete or a refusing commit hook, when the release runs, then it prints one line about it and the release goes on.
